title: Filling a ten frame to see numbers
examples: How do I show thirteen on a ten frame?

explain.say: Imagine an egg box with ten spaces: two rows of five. That is a ten frame! Look at the board. Six counters are sitting in it. How many empty spaces can you see?

draw.text: Filling a ten frame to see numbers

explain.say: Here is eight. Look at the empty spaces: there are two. So eight needs two more to make ten. The empty spaces tell you how far you are from ten! Can you spot the gaps?
Now the frame is full: ten! Every space has a counter. Ten is a super important number in maths. Clap ten times with me!
What about thirteen? One full frame is ten, and three more go in a new frame. Ten and three make thirteen. Can you see the full ten and the three?
Sixteen: one full ten, and six more. Teen numbers are always ten and some more! Brilliant! Challenge: use an egg box and buttons to make your age.

faq.a: A ten frame is a box with two rows of five spaces, ten spaces in all. You put counters in it to see numbers.
asks: Tell me about the ten frame

faq.q: Why are the empty spaces useful?
faq.a: The empty spaces show how many more you need to make ten. Eight counters leave two spaces, so eight and two make ten.

faq.q: How do I show numbers bigger than ten?
faq.a: Fill one frame to make ten, then put the rest in a second frame. Thirteen is one full frame and three more.
Teen numbers, like thirteen and sixteen, are ten and some more. Sixteen is ten and six.

faq.q: Can I make my own ten frame?
faq.a: Yes! An egg box with ten cups, or two rows of five squares drawn on paper, works well. Use buttons, beans or coins as counters. A grown-up can help you make it.
asks: How do I make a ten frame?

facts: A ten frame has two rows of five spaces.
Every teen number, from eleven to nineteen, is ten and some more ones.

quiz.say: A ten frame has 7 counters. How many spaces are empty?
quiz.show: 7 counters in a ten frame. How many empty spaces?
quiz.why: Seven and three make ten, so three spaces are empty.

wrong.1: Seven and four make eleven, which is too many for one frame.
wrong.2: Seven is how many counters there are, not how many spaces are empty.

quiz.say: One full ten frame and 5 more makes how many?
quiz.show: A full ten frame and 5 more makes…

wrong.1: Five is just the extra part. Do not forget the full ten.
wrong.2: Ten is just the full frame. Add the five more.
